_comment: Structural keys ({ key } records) whose names are only known at run time (process.env) are handed to an external module and handed back: one holds its name when handed over, one is given its key after the handover. Tim's decision (2026-11-09): a runtime name in a program key object's key field is not tracked once the object is handed to unseen code, on the ground that the case is rare (the object is the program's own, so the scalar rationale does not apply). Both lookups keep nothing, so all four of their method definitions go and the bundle is not run. A literal-named structural key is the control: its read method stays, its unread one goes. Canonical keys returned by unseen code stay covered (external_identity_key, external_returned_key_held).
